reviewed_by: Claude Code, finishing the live 111e6da promotion stopped by an unreconcilable target receipt
reason: Live promotion of 111e6da stopped at target_execution: Core applied the target (deployment status shows target_execution_version 111e6da) but the receipt is uncertain, and Core's reconcile endpoint answers 409 for actions without a durable outcome record. reconcile_operation re-raised every HTTP error except 404/405, so the deployer aborted with 'HTTP Error 409: Conflict' instead of settling the step from deployment status as StagedDeployer._operation is designed to. A 409 now returns Core's unchanged receipt, so the uncertain step is settled from status evidence or kept held; nothing is replayed. The resume-suite fixture replaced reconcile_operation and returned uncertain receipts directly, which hid the bug; it now models Core's 409 and uses the real wrapper (11 uncertain-path tests fail on main against it). Selected: the deploy-resume suite (new target case) and the staged-deployer suite.
exclusions: Deployer script and its test fixture only; no Core, UI or API change. Core's reconcile still cannot prove target_execution; teaching Core a durable outcome for it is a separate change. tests/test_simulation_host_restart.py and test_simulation_dead_owner_activation.py pass locally except two host-switch signalling cases that fail on unmodified main here and pass in CI.
